code: download <- function(url) {   # A stand-in for utils::download.file(url, path).   path <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")   utils::write.csv(mtcars, path, row.names = FALSE)   path }  cached_download <- function(s, url) {   path <- cache_get(s, url, default = NULL)   if (is.null(path)) {     tmp <- download(url)     cache_set(s, url, tmp, codec = codec_file(), expire = 7 * 24 * 3600)     unlink(tmp)     path <- cache_get(s, url)   }   path }  path <- cached_download(s, "https://example.org/mtcars.csv") basename(path) #> [1] "450a97ba6b438c6ea5bdf2aaac7eab0ecbbf812b5ff74b56f62dcf0a0c7eb0e5.csv" nrow(utils::read.csv(path)) #> [1] 32

title: Operating a shared cache
text: number processes can read , never wait: read sees last committed state. Writes take turns. write waits longer timeout seconds (60 default) another process’s write raises dazcache_busy, hang. process opens cache . handle carried forked child, parallel::mclapply() worker. Using raises dazcache_forked, open cache inside worker: Workers started fresh processes (‘callr’, ‘mirai’, ‘future’ multisession) nothing inherit, open cache like process. Every single operation atomic across processes. Eight processes calling cache_incr() one key count eight. cache_add() writes entry. cache_pop() reads deletes one step.
code: parallel::mclapply(keys, function(k) {   s <- cache(dir)   on.exit(cache_close(s))   cache_get(s, k, default = NULL) }) cache_incr(s, "jobs-run") #> [1] 1 cache_add(s, "lock/nightly", Sys.getpid(), expire = 3600) #> [1] TRUE cache_add(s, "lock/nightly", Sys.getpid()) #> [1] FALSE

title: Operating a shared cache
text: cache_transact() makes block writes atomic: commit, none . holds write lock runs, processes’ writes wait . Keep short, never compute something slow inside . also fastest way write many entries: making write durable expensive part, transaction pays . Memoised functions follow rule. Two processes miss call moment compute , one result kept. duplicated work, never wrong answer.
code: cache_set(s, "balance", 100) cache_transact(s, {   cache_set(s, "balance", cache_get(s, "balance") - 30)   cache_incr(s, "withdrawals") }) #> [1] 1 cache_get(s, "balance") #> [1] 70

title: Persistent Disk Cache Shared Between Processes
text: dazcache persistent disk cache every R process machine can share, style Python’s diskcache. Keys map values outlive session, expire clock, carry tags bulk invalidation, evicted cache grows past size limit. Small values live transactional libmdbx database, mdbx package; larger ones become read-files named content, stored however many keys hold .

code: library(dazcache)  s <- cache(file.path(tempdir(), "prices"))  # Keys map to values, with expiry and tags. s |> cache_set("XSWX/2026-08-29", c(101.2, 101.9), expire = 3600, tags = "XSWX") cache_get(s, "XSWX/2026-08-29") #> [1] 101.2 101.9 cache_get(s, "missing", default = NULL) #> NULL  # A key can be any combination of values; field order does not matter. cache_set(s, list(exchange = "XSWX", date = as.Date("2026-08-29")), "quotes") cache_get(s, list(date = as.Date("2026-08-29"), exchange = "XSWX")) #> [1] "quotes"  # A function, cached across sessions and processes. slow_square <- function(x) {   Sys.sleep(1)   x^2 } square <- cache_memoise(slow_square, s) system.time(square(12)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.003   0.000   1.034 system.time(square(12)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.000   0.000   0.001  # The catalogue is a data frame. cache_entries(s)[, c("key", "bytes", "codec", "expires")] #>                                   key bytes codec             expires #> 1                     XSWX/2026-08-29    47   rds 2026-09-29 19:59:14 #> 2             slow_square/v1/{x=i:12}    39   rds                <NA> #> 3 {date=d:2026-08-29,exchange=s:XSWX}     6   raw                <NA>  cache_close(s)

what: dazcache: Persistent Disk Cache Shared Between Processes — dazcache-package
title: dazcache: Persistent Disk Cache Shared Between Processes — dazcache-package
text: persistent, size-bounded cache several 'R' processes one machine can share, style 'Python' library 'diskcache'. Keys map values outlive session, expire clock, carry tags bulk invalidation, evicted cache grows past limit. Metadata small values live transactional 'libmdbx' database 'mdbx' package, larger values stored content-addressed files. Functions can memoised across sessions processes, cache can used 'cachem' interface.

title: dazcache 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. persistent cache shared every R process machine: cache() opens directory; cache_get(), cache_set(), cache_has(), cache_delete(), cache_mget() cache_mset() read write ; cache_keys(), cache_entries(), cache_count(), cache_volume() cache_stats() describe . Keys text, R value specified key encoding covers (cache_key()), cache keyed function arguments survives R upgrades. Small values live transactional ‘libmdbx’ database ‘mdbx’; values inline_max bytes become read-, content-addressed files, stored however many keys hold (cache_path()). Entries expire (expire =, cache_expire()), carry tags (cache_evict(tag =)), evicted least-recently-stored first cache holds size_limit (cache_cull()). Atomic operations across processes: cache_add(), cache_pop(), cache_touch(), cache_incr(), cache_decr() cache_transact(). cache_memoise() caches function’s results across sessions processes; as_cachem() lets ‘memoise’ ‘shiny’ use cache. cache_check() finds repairs damage, reclaims crash leaves.
